description: This file defines the SessionManager class responsible for managing user session state, including authentication status, access tokens, refresh tokens, and interaction with Keychain for secure storage. It handles login, logout, token refresh, and session restoration functions.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: A final class conforming to ObservableObject that manages user session state, including token management, session persistence, and authentication lifecycle.

methods.name: restoreFromKeychainIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts to restore session tokens from the Keychain, validates expiration, and refreshes tokens if needed.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, persists tokens, and updates session state.

methods.name: authorizedRequestToken
methods.description: Provides a valid access token, refreshing if necessary, or throws an error if not authenticated.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, invalidates session with the API, and clears stored data.

methods.name: refreshIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks token expiration and refreshes tokens via API if they are expired or about to expire.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Updates in-memory session variables with new token data.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Stores tokens in the Keychain securely.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears tokens from secure storage and resets in-memory session variables.

methods.name: clearInMemory
methods.description: Resets in-memory session state variables to logged out status.
